meta.title: GearUp — Find compatible parts for your machine
meta.description: Enter brand and model to instantly discover which fuel and parts are compatible with your machine.

hero.eyebrow: Never search for the right parts again
hero.lead: Enter the brand and model of your lawnmower, chainsaw or brush cutter — and instantly see which fuel and parts fit it.
hero.hint: Type freely: brand and model, e.g. “Honda HRG 416” or “Stihl MS 250”. The model number is on a sticker or type plate.

categories.title: Which machine are you looking for?
categories.subtitle: Pick a type to browse brands and models

suggestions.lead: Don't know the model number? Click the card that looks like your machine. Otherwise the model number is on a sticker or type plate on the machine.

empty.title: This model isn't in our database yet
empty.body: We couldn't find “{query}”. We're constantly adding models — but we'd rather show nothing than something that might be wrong.
empty.body_noquery: We couldn't find this model. We're constantly adding models — but we'd rather show nothing than something that might be wrong.
empty.noted: We've noted your search. The more often a model is searched, the sooner we add it.
empty.general_text: Most 4-stroke lawnmowers run on regular Euro 95 (E5/E10) petrol and you don't mix it with oil — the engine oil sits separately in the crankcase. On 2-stroke machines you do mix oil into the petrol. Always check your manual or the type plate for the exact details of your machine.

result.more_gear_title: Looking for more gear for your {model}?
result.more_gear_sub: Open a part for the three best buying options.
result.coming_soon_desc: This product will be added soon.
result.manual_description: Find the official manual for your machine.
result.disclaimer: GearUp is independent. We don't sell anything ourselves — we show you where to buy the right part. Through the links we earn a small commission; the price doesn't change for you. Advice checked at model level.
